adapter.label: Local network
adapter.needs: Needs a network address on this computer that other devices on the same network can reach. Traffic is not encrypted.

address.scope: selected interface address with an OS-assigned port
conditions: firewall and routing are the owner’s prerequisites
no TLS: HTTPS-required clients cannot use it

cost.summary: Gozar charges nothing and there is no provider; the owned local forwarder uses your own network.

disclosure.text: Expose this service on a selected local network interface over plain HTTP through an owned forwarder. Anyone on that network path can read the traffic.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. Backed by validation.sse (timed incremental event delivery when required) and validation.publish (exact-origin approval only after all required probes) in the wrapped recipe definition, with admission.requiredFeatures probe-assertions and client-vantage-probe.
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr false: the origin is plain HTTP on a local address, not a stable HTTPS origin.
